title: Radical Brook rearrangement: past, present, and future
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,1870-1904
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01275E, Review Article
Yunxiao Zhang, Gang Zhou, Shanshan Liu, Xiao Shen
This review aims to provide an overview of radical Brook rearrangement, which is organized by grouping three type of reactive species generated via the unique rearrangement process.
